title: Bunny dancing
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- ground shadow -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='90' rx='26' ry='5' fill='#1b2a4a'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='22' rx='6' ry='16' fill='#f2a6b8' transform='rotate(-12 38 22)'/>
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='20' rx='6' ry='16' fill='#f2a6b8' transform='rotate(14 62 20)'/>
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='23' rx='2.8' ry='11' fill='#ffd3de' transform='rotate(-12 38 23)'/>
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='21' rx='2.8' ry='11' fill='#ffd3de' transform='rotate(14 62 21)'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='68' rx='19' ry='17' fill='#f5f0e6'/>
  <!-- left arm raised -->
  <ellipse cx='28' cy='58' rx='6' ry='10' fill='#f5f0e6' transform='rotate(30 28 58)'/>
  <!-- right arm raised -->
  <ellipse cx='72' cy='56' rx='6' ry='10' fill='#f5f0e6' transform='rotate(-35 72 56)'/>
  <!-- feet -->
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='86' rx='8' ry='4.5' fill='#ffe9b0'/>
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='85' rx='8' ry='4.5' fill='#ffe9b0'/>
  <!-- tummy -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='72' rx='11' ry='10' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='40' r='15' fill='#f5f0e6'/>
  <!-- cheeks -->
  <circle cx='41' cy='45' r='3' fill='#ffb3c6'/>
  <circle cx='59' cy='45' r='3' fill='#ffb3c6'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='44' cy='38' r='2.6' fill='#3a2e4a'/>
  <circle cx='56' cy='38' r='2.6' fill='#3a2e4a'/>
  <circle cx='44.8' cy='37.2' r='0.9' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='56.8' cy='37.2' r='0.9' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- nose and smile -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='44' r='1.8' fill='#ff8fab'/>
  <path d='M46 48 Q50 51 54 48' stroke='#8a6b78' stroke-width='1.4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- music notes -->
  <circle cx='80' cy='30' r='3' fill='#7ee0c0'/>
  <rect x='82' y='18' width='1.8' height='12' fill='#7ee0c0'/>
  <circle cx='20' cy='26' r='2.5' fill='#ffd166'/>
  <rect x='21.6' y='15' width='1.6' height='11' fill='#ffd166'/>
</svg>
